# Goal

We aim to fix all the issues that we're previously present within our model.

## Diversification score

Run this after `funds` has been created in `main.Rmd`. The ETF data has
stock and bond weights but not the other individual asset weights, so
we combine all remaining assets into one group for both fund types.
The score is 0 when all assets are in one group and rises as the three
groups become more evenly weighted.

```{r diversification}
library(dplyr)

funds <- funds %>%
  mutate(
    diversification = 1 - (
      asset_stocks^2 +
      asset_bonds^2 +
      (1 - asset_stocks - asset_bonds)^2
    )
  )
```

To use this predictor, replace `asset_stocks + asset_bonds` with
`diversification` in the model formula.
